serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
The skin of the sausage is nicely fried, but the inside is still juicy and yummy. Sadly the onion wasn’t fresh, but it still works well together.
Although, there’s something that I can’t put my finger on.
The taste of this sausage is a bit different. I ate this supermarket sausage many times so I know exactly how it tastes, but there’s a small change…
You: {f_botName}, did you add something to the sausage?
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
Bot: Oh, so you noticed.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
You: Should I be scared?
Bot: Of course not! I didn’t do anything weird to it! 
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: To make the sausage more flavorful, I marinated it in soda before frying.
You: Really? I would never have guessed it.
#bot.Expression.happy
You: It’s really good, great job!
Bot: Thank you for the praise!
Bot: I will also make you something hot to drink to stimulate your stomach. Sausage might be hard to digest.
You: I will take you up on your offer.
